consequences: On day 20 of each month at 10:00 IST, QED redeems the units of UTI Nifty 50 Index Fund (Direct, Growth) that come to ₹10,000 at the latest NAV.

The fund house prices the redemption at the NAV for its own day, so the money that arrives can differ a little from ₹10,000. The exit load is taken from it; tax on the gain is not, and is yours to pay later.
When the units run out it sells what is left and ends. It never buys.
warnings: A withdrawal sells units at the NAV published for its day. If the fund falls, the same rupees take more units and the units run out sooner. A fall in value is not a limit this plan can stop.
It asks you before every run. A request you do not answer within 24 hours lapses, and that withdrawal does not happen.
